keyEvents.text: Goal! Italy 0, France 1. Michael Olise (France) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Jérémy Jacquet (France) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Italy 1, France 1. Francesco Pio Esposito (Italy) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Nicolò Cambiaghi.
